title: The Sky Palace Inhabit the Infinite
description: Tranquility pervades all aspects of AVA at Palm Jumeirah. From strolling in the grounds along the waterfront to entering the cool of the atrium; from stepping from the lift into your light-filled residence to standing on your private terrace enthralled by a vista of city and sea, AVA at Palm Jumeirah has been conceived to ensure that each element of your experience is imbued with calm. As the first building at the threshold of the world- renowned Palm Jumeirah, AVA at Palm Jumeirah occupies an incomparable position right at the very centre of Dubai. It is ideally placed to afford privileged access to both the calm of the waterfront and the dynamism of this global city. Rising above the water, AVA at Palm Jumeirah Dubai’s organic form brings a distinctive silhouette to Dubai’s skyline. The crown of AVA at Palm Jumeirah is devoted to one of the most sumptuous mega penthouses in the world. Unique in the truest sense of the word, this residence unites over multiple levels, boasting true elegance in design with a dedication to ensuring every detail is fully considered. The Sky Palace creates unequivocal space, volume and opportunity to truly explore the limits of what a life well-lived can be in AVA at Palm Jumeirah, Dorchester Collection, Dubai. Spread over four floors, this incomparable 33,406 sq. ft. residence will garner global attention from those who covet a day in the life of the owner. The Sky Palace at AVA at Palm Jumeirah, Dorchester Collection, Dubai, affords its own private amenities, alongside exclusive access to the amenities of AVA at Palm Jumeirah, plus working in harmony with its neighbouring tower, One at Palm Jumeirah, also managed by Dorchester Collection. Situated on the shores of the Gulf, from the very first moment, it is clear that AVA at Palm Jumeirah is beyond compare. Be it an expansive apartment or the palatial Sky Palace covering numerous floors, each residence in AVA at Palm Jumeirah is completely individual your own oasis.

Viewing is essential to appreciate this exceptional residence and destination. Contact Luxury Residences, the market’s leading specialists and former developer sales team, to arrange your private showing today.

Positioned on the Crescent Road, the residence connects effortlessly to Dubai Marina, DIFC, Jumeirah, and Downtown.

title: Duplex | Roof Terrace | Golf and Skyline Views
address: Panorama At The Views Tower 2, Dubai,
description: Welcome to the exceptional! Luxury Residences, the home of mansions, penthouses and branded residences, is delighted to bring to market this exquisite property within the much-revered Panorama complex in the highly sought-after Views community. Within Panorama, residents enjoy best-in-class facilities, including a swimming pool, sun deck, children’s pool, gymnasium, indoor games room, children’s play area, barbecue area and more, while the central location gives excellent access to lifestyle, schooling, healthcare and retail. Perfect for families and those with a penchant for golf, this fabulous home commands some of the most breathtaking views in Dubai. From its elevated penthouse position, vistas sweep across Emirates Golf Club towards the Marina, JBR and the Palm skyline – a truly memorable sight at sunset. A recent renovation elevates the residence well beyond its peers. Level One: private entrance foyer, beautifully appointed fitted kitchen, open-plan living and dining room with terrace, laundry and utility room, and a guest bathroom and maids bathroom. Level Two: home study area, three generously proportioned bedrooms with master en-suite, a large terrace with incredible views, and the main family bathroom. Roof Level: an expansive private roof terrace with 180-degree views across Dubai – perfect for relaxing and entertaining through the winter months. As currently arranged, it also features a home office, offering welcome separation from the main living space. The residence is presented in fantastic condition throughout, with a warm, inviting tone reminiscent of a country home – a credit to the owner, who has invested considerably, both financially and with great care. This combination of layout, views and condition is exceptionally rare within the community. Viewing is essential to appreciate how special this home is. We cordially invite you to register your interest, request further details or arrange a private viewing soon to avoid disappointment.

The villas also come with generous outdoor spaces, perfect for recreation and entertaining.

title: Exclusive | Lagoon Facing | Available for Viewing
address: Chorisia II, Dubai, Al Barari
description: Luxury Residences are delighted to present this exclusive 5 bedroom Chorisia 2 villa facing the lagoon for rent. Inspired by one of the most beautiful trees in the world, these semi-detached villas are meticulously designed and planned to complement Al Barari’s existing portfolio. The collection of exquisite five-bedroom villas offers distinctive green living with inspired architecture and captivating views amid a relaxed and elegant atmosphere. Chorisia 2 offers 5 ensuite bedrooms, an open living and dining area, an entrance hall, a covered garage, an open kitchen that is flexible to be closed with its amenities (laundry room, maids room), a powder room, and an office space. Designed with a connection to nature at the core, floor-to-ceiling glass that gazes upon the beautiful central courtyard. The office, kitchen, and living spaces open to the interior courtyard and to an outdoor garden and private pool. Offering an unprecedented approach to sustainable living where family interaction and development is a focus. A unique destination. A place where you can live, stay, play, shop, dine, and work. From the Arabic word meaning ‘wilderness’, Al Barari is the region’s first integrated luxury and active eco-conscious development. A strategically located green community in the heart of the city provides an environment that enhances wellness for residents and visitors alike. Residents can immerse themselves in the abundant greenery surrounded by a sparkling waterway. title: Royal PH | Private Pool | View Today | Sea View
address: Six Senses Residences, Dubai, Palm Jumeirah
description: Luxury Residences, the home of mansions, penthouses and branded residences, is pleased to present this brand-new, never-lived-in, exclusive four-bedroom Royal Penthouse complimented with private pool and terrace at Six Senses Residences, The Palm Jumeirah. Positioned on the highest floor along the iconic West Crescent, this residence commands spectacular open sea and sunset views, with a unique layout spanning 7,361 sq ft (684 sq m) total across four bedrooms plus maid's room and is delivered fully fitted and unfurnished. Handover is scheduled for September 2026. As Six Senses' first branded address in the UAE, this beachfront development pairs a boutique hotel with ultra-luxury residences on a private stretch of the Palm Jumeirah coastline. Coral-inspired architecture, with undulating rooflines and cellular facades, echoes the region's reef ecosystems. At its heart sits a 60,000 sq ft wellness and social hub, featuring a longevity clinic, IV lounge, biohacking room, massage circuit pool, squash court, co-working spaces and a Six Senses Spa, alongside hydrotherapy areas, an Alchemy Bar and yoga and meditation spaces. Owners also enjoy privileged access to hotel-grade amenities and services: 24/7 concierge and valet Housekeeping, laundry, nanny service and gourmet in-room dining Gymnasium, tennis and padel courts, jogging trails Health spa with sauna and steam rooms Private beach and swimming pools Fine dining, bars and a residents' library Children's soft play area, kids' club and function spaces On-site micro-farm with fresh, organic produce Underground parking and landscaped grounds Managed end-to-end by Six Senses, this residence offers a rare fusion of private living and world-class resort hospitality — waking up to uninterrupted sea views with five-star service on hand, without ever leaving home. Contact Luxury Residences now to schedule your private viewing and for further details!

descriptionHtml:
Discover unparalleled elegance in this meticulously renovated 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom private residence measuring an impressive 4,740 square feet (440 square meters) at Atlantis The Royal Residences located on the internationally sought after Palm Jumeirah.

This turnkey masterpiece underwent an extensive 18-month renovation with a AED 15 million investment, personally overseen by the distinguished family owners for their own use, and executed by the internationally acclaimed XBD Collective.

Exquisite Design and Furnishings:

  • Exclusive accessories from Hermes, Baccarat, Lladro, and Lalique
  • Italian-imported furniture from Longhi and Eichholtz
  • Onyx features and a Planika fireplace from Italy
  • Italian mirror TV
  • Murano glass coffee tables by Cornelio Cappellini
  • Bespoke lighting from San Souci
  • Handmade Turkish carpets
  • Designer wallpaper finishes
  • Bespoke joinery in all bedrooms
  • Sahara Noir marble kitchen countertops
  • Custom Barrisol ceiling in the relaxation room
  • Floor-to-ceiling mirrored feature walls

Luxurious Bathrooms:

  • High-end finishes and custom-made fixtures with spa like features
  • Expansive walk-in showers and freestanding tubs
  • Dual vanities
  • Bespoke Italian marble and elegant lighting

Advanced Technology:

  • Sonance ceiling speakers
  • Lutron home automation for lighting, TV, and curtains control via iPad
  • Samsung 4K TVs with subwoofers and sound bars
  • Logitech video conferencing equipment in the office area
  • 85" surround sound system with integrated wall speakers in the media room

Generous Living Space:

  • Luxurious Italian marble in the front of house and bathrooms
  • German Siematic kitchens with premium Gaggenau appliances
  • 3m+ high ceilings
  • Fully retractable window systems
  • Private terraces with panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai's skyline

Hotel and Residence Amenities:

  • Michelin starred chefs and multiple dining options including Nobu, Ling Ling, Dinner by Heston Blumenthal and Milos
  • Infinity sky pool at Cloud 22
  • Exclusive "black tier" membership with 30% discount within the resort
  • Complimentary boardroom access and business suites
  • BBQ with outdoor kitchen
  • Concierge & valet services
  • Room service menus from the hotel
  • Housekeeping & laundry on demand
  • Indoor and outdoor pools
  • Tennis court
  • Private beachfront
  • Lounge and library
  • Children's playground
  • Spa, sauna, steam room, and relaxation garden
  • EV charging points
  • Service lift for staff and deliveries

Key Benefits:

  • Turnkey to an expectational standard
  • Owned by the Dubai sovereign wealth fund ICD via their hospitality company Kerzner International (Atlantis and One&Only)
  • Global architectural icon and Dubai's new landmark
  • Uninterrupted skyline and sea views
  • 5-star ultra-luxury resort
  • Exclusive resident privileges and discounts
  • Super prime location on the Crescent, Palm Jumeirah

This exquisite branded residence at Atlantis The Royal offers the finest in luxury living, combining elegant design, advanced technology, and exclusive amenities in one of Dubai's most sought-after destinations.

Please contact us to receive further details and to arrange a private viewing by appointment!

title: One at Palm Jumeirah, Dorchester Collection
description: One at Palm Jumeirah, Dorchester Collection, Dubai, is a completely reimagined approach to elegance and exclusivity. Iconic architecture, sprawling layouts, unbeatable amenities, lush green spaces, and the most sought-after interior features make One at Palm Jumeirah more than a residence – it is a veritable masterpiece of artful design and the pinnacle of luxurious living in all its aspects. Completed in 2006, Palm Jumeirah is unquestionably Dubai’s most spectacular location and a world icon. A marvel of modern engineering, the island boasts pristine beaches surrounded by the crystal blue waters of the Arabian Gulf – a prime destination for those who can appreciate an ultra-exclusive lifestyle. This one-of-a-kind setting now features a remarkable collection of stunning residences at its most prime position. The timeless elegance of your home at One at Palm Jumeirah deserves a backdrop that sets it off like a precious jewel in an elegant setting. Floor-to-ceiling glass enables you to look out over sweeping, 360-degree vistas of the Gulf and the exciting Dubai skyline in an inspiring, ever-changing display of sea, sky and light. Cutting-edge architecture, exclusively designed luscious interiors, the seamless coherence of privacy and association, make your home at One at Palm Jumeirah, Dorchester Collection, Dubai truly a cut above everything else. But what makes One at Palm Jumeirah even more spectacular is the sense of freedom, infinity and true bliss that comes from enjoying daily views that encompass everything on the horizon and beyond. Welcome to your home, where minimalist beauty meets an exquisite, staggered layout. The strikingly consonant design of One at Palm Jumeirah gives you both privacy and interaction. With three separate cores making up the structure, each elevator leads to no more than two residences. Working in conjunction with the natural environment, One at Palm Jumeirah uses the brilliant natural light of Dubai along with transcendent green spaces to offer a home that is truly a unique pearl. One at Palm Jumeirah, Dorchester Collection, Dubai, offers unique benefits to its esteemed residents-each one a true connoisseur of luxury and indulgence. Thus the amenities have been created with precisely such experience and expertise in mind, aiming to satisfy even the most demanding of tastes. Residents will be able to experience a dazzling array of services and amenities that nourish and rejuvenate, entertain and delight, relax and soothe. Meeting facilities, lounges, library, many different swimming pools, children’s areas, and much more is in store for our beloved residents.

title: Oasis of Comfort and Privacy
description: Situatedon the crescent of the world-renowned landmark, Palm Jumeriah, ORLAoccupies a beachfront position right at the pinnacle of Dubai’sarchipelago. Yourresidence at ORLA is your exclusive escape, where indoor and outdoorblend seamlessly with sea and sky, as energising light streamsthrough each residence creating eternal vistas from the moment thesun rises above the horizon to the last golden rays shimmering offthe sea below. Offeringthe finest amenities and five-star service, for the pleasure ofresidents of ORLA’s 85 residences, 3 sky palaces, and 1 luxurymansion, you will find privacy, prestige and personalised servicefrom the moment you set foot in the vast, elevated lobby. ORLAimmerses you in balance and beauty, fostering a deep connection withyour space and surroundings. The architecture is conceptualisedthrough the lens of natural elements, integrating flowing waterfeatures and lush greenery to erase boundaries and let positiveenergy flow through the property. Organicby design, ORLA’s towers are linked together to optimise the windflow to assist in channelling the cooling breezes to the residencesand situated to allow residents to enjoy both sunrise and sunsetexperiences. EachORLA residence has a seamless arrival experience unique to each homewith the discerning choice of a direct lift arrival experience,stepping from lift into your light filled residence within moments,for the most impressive entrance. Alternative front door entrancesare also available, so you still have the freedom to choose howguests can enter your ORLA residence. ORLA’s85 tower residences and 3 sky palaces are a mix of two, three andfour-bedroom units floating above the resort and shimmering sea. Eachhave a unique layout spread over one or two storeys, ensuring thebest use of each space and providing an array of options to suitevery resident’s individual desires. Aniconic luxury peninsula with a unique connection to the sea, the PalmJumeirah is a destination without peer, with many of Dubai’s finestrestaurants, clubs and beach resorts only moments away, while therest of the wonders of Dubai lie within easy reach. Situatedon an 29,000 square-metre beachfront plot at the apex of the Palm’screscent, ORLA enjoys a privileged position and uninterrupted270-degree views from Dubai’s sky-scraping skyline to the turquoisewaters of the Arabian Gulf that stretch to the horizon.

Serenity Mansions Aurora is situated within the prestigious Tilal Al Ghaf community, an exceptional residential area known for its stunning lagoon and lush green surroundings. These exclusive residences offer a serene retreat with architecture that marries modern luxury with nature's tranquillity. The homes provide uninterrupted views of the landscaped gardens, ensuring a private and peaceful living environment while still being just minutes away from the vibrant energy of Dubai. At Serenity Mansions Aurora, the beauty of nature is ever-present. Each residence is positioned to offer panoramic views, whether it’s the lush greenery of Tilal Al Ghaf or the sparkling waters of the community's central lagoon. These homes are designed to provide an idyllic living experience, where the boundary between indoor luxury and the natural world is beautifully blurred. title: Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina
description: Born out of unrivaled craftsmanship, visionary design, and a profound sense of place, Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina emerges as an address unlike any other. Soaring 122 stories above the pulsating heart of one of Dubai’s most coveted addresses, the extraordinary tower provides an unparalleled living experience, effortlessly blending with the dynamic energy and vibrancy of Dubai's global metropolis. Reflecting a shared philosophy between its design and ‘The City of the Future’, Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina presents itself on the world stage as the tallest residential tower of its time. Set to transform the Dubai Marina skyline, this iconic structure not only reaches unprecedented heights but is a testament to progressive design and architectural excellence. With a slender silhouette, its outer facade serves as a canvas of meticulous elegance, seamlessly integrating into the dynamic landscape of Dubai Marina, distinctly asserting its character while rightfully taking its place as a timeless landmark of the city. Showcasing 251 exquisite residences, Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina features an array of unit typologies and sizes, ranging from two-to-four bedroom deluxe residences, four-bedroom half-floor penthouses, to ultra-luxurious four-and five-bedroom duplex and triplex Sky Mansions. Each of the residences is meticulously designed to promote sustainability, well-being and contentment, integrating Sleep With Six Senses bedroom amenities and incorporating elements inspired by biophilia and classical feng shui. The residences command sweeping panoramas that capture the entirety of Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Harbour Beachfront, Emirates Golf Course, Dubai Marina, Blue Waters, and Ain Dubai. Six Senses Residences Dubai Marina is scheduled for completion in 2028.

This sleek, modern, and move-in-ready private home is offered fully furnished for a discerning tenant. Spanning a thoughtfully planned 2,212 sqft (206 sqm), the residence boasts unmatched views of the resort gardens, pools, beachfront, Palm Jumeirah, and the spectacular Dubai skyline. title: The Chedi Private Residences
building: The Chedi Private Residences, Sheikh Zayed Road
description: For over three decades, The Chedi has been synonymous with timeless elegance, refined hospitality, and seamless integration of heritage and modernity. From the pristine shores of Oman to the cultural vibrance of Japan, The Chedi’s global portfolio of award-winning destinations embodies a unique philosophy of understated luxury. Now, this esteemed legacy arrives in Dubai with The Chedi Private Residences—a landmark development offering an unprecedented lifestyle experience. Ideally located on Sheikh Zayed Road, this groundbreaking development is the world’s first standalone private branded residence under The Chedi name. Soaring 240 meters over 52 floors, this architectural marvel, with its sleek glass faÇade, is masterfully designedby the award-winning Studio Bruno Guelaff. Redefining grandeur, The Chedi Private Residences presents an exclusive collection of sky villas and world-class amenities, offering a lifestyle beyond the extraordinary. Discover an exclusive collection of expansive residences, ranging from two- to five-bedroom villas and duplexes to the extraordinary triplex Pinnacle Mansion—a one-of-a-kind masterpiece crowning the building. Experience unparalleled luxury and design in every detail. The Chedi Private Residences perfectly balances this captivating energy and sophistication with the serenity of an exclusive retreat. From the elegant arrival experience to the exclusive rooftop residents’ Sky Social, every space is thoughtfully crafted to foster meaningful connections while providing a serene atmosphere for personal reflection. Each area achieves a harmonious balance, seamlessly blending opportunities for social engagement with moments of tranquil solitude. The Chedi Private Residences offers an exceptional range of premium amenities across three distinct levels: Ground Social, Resort Social, and Sky Social. Each level is meticulously designed to enrich the resident experience, offering curated spaces for relaxation, entertainment, and social engagement. The Ground and Resort levels feature a blend of essential amenities and leisure spaces, while the Sky Social level offers an exclusive atmosphere with an adults-only infinity pool, Omakase experience, Sky Bar & Lounge, ensuring a luxurious living experience at every turn.

title: Ultra-Rare 2BR Duplex in the Iconic Uptown Tower
address: Uptown Tower, Dubai, Jumeirah Lake Towers
description: Introducing an exceptionally rare opportunity to acquire a two-bedroom duplex within the SO/ Uptown Residences, part of the iconic new DMCC Headquarters Tower. This exclusive property type is among the most limited in availability, blending stylish Parisian-inspired design with the sophistication of Dubai’s newest business and lifestyle landmark. Strategically positioned minutes from Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence, Emirates Living, and Jumeirah Islands, SO/ Uptown Residences offers effortless access to the city’s most vibrant districts. The community rises as a new hub for business, leisure, and entertainment—just a short drive from the upcoming Al Maktoum International Airport, set to become the world’s largest, and the highly anticipated Palm Jebel Ali, Dubai’s next premier beachfront destination. Residents of the SO/ Uptown Residences enjoy an unmatched lifestyle supported by world-class amenities: 24-hour concierge and valet service, residents’ lounge, an infinity pool and jacuzzi, Technogym-equipped fitness studio, private cinema room, and business lounge. Residents also enjoy on-demand à la carte hotel services from the Sofitel SO Hotel, and an exclusive 20% privilege across all restaurants and spa treatments. At the heart of the development lies The Atrium—a stunning multi-level vertical garden and entertainment venue, featuring cafés, gourmet restaurants, and green spaces in a vibrant urban environment. This unique duplex residence enjoys panoramic city and skyline views, best appreciated in person. A masterpiece of design and lifestyle, it invites those with discerning taste to experience the next generation of branded living.

title: A Journey to Sublime Sophistication
description: Rising high above the gentle flow of the Marasi Bay, VELA, Dorchester Collection, Dubai, is a sublime celebration of contemporary waterfront in Dubai. Inspiring architecture, spacious design and wonderful views meet to create a place of true beauty. Bringing together the vibrancy of Downtown Dubai with the peace and prestige of the Marasi Bay waterfront, VELA presents a doorway to an elevated way of life, immersed in beauty and surrounded by energy. The immediate access to the tranquility of the sea, directly from your own marina mooring is extremely special. Rising at 150-metre-tall, VELA provides a gross floor area of 272,860 sq. ft. spread over 30 floors. The 38 residences range in size from 4,253 sq. ft. to 11,727 sq. ft. and encompass sumptuous penthouses and three- and four-bedroom properties, some with double height living spaces and private terrace pools. The tower is crowned by the Sky Palace which covers 22,992 sq. ft. spread over 3 floors with two swimming pools, grand terraces, a private gym and majlis. VELA has been crafted by award-winning practice Foster + Partners, the masterminds behind Apple’s California headquarters, France’s dramatic Millau Viaduct and London’s ‘Gherkin’ tower. descriptionHtml:
Rising high above the gentle flow of the Marasi Bay, VELA, Dorchester Collection, Dubai, is a sublime celebration of contemporary waterfront in Dubai.

Inspiring architecture, spacious design and wonderful views meet to create a place of true beauty.

Bringing together the vibrancy of Downtown Dubai with the peace and prestige of the Marasi Bay waterfront, VELA presents a doorway to an elevated way of life, immersed in beauty and surrounded by energy.

The immediate access to the tranquility of the sea, directly from your own marina mooring is extremely special.

Rising at 150-metre-tall, VELA provides a gross floor area of 272,860 sq. ft. spread over 30 floors. The 38 residences range in size from 4,253 sq. ft. to 11,727 sq. ft. and encompass sumptuous penthouses and three- and four-bedroom properties, some with double height living spaces and private terrace pools.

The tower is crowned by the Sky Palace which covers 22,992 sq. ft. spread over 3 floors with two swimming pools, grand terraces, a private gym and majlis.

VELA has been crafted by award-winning practice Foster + Partners, the masterminds behind Apple’s California headquarters, France’s dramatic Millau Viaduct and London’s ‘Gherkin’ tower. The firm has garnered various awards, including the coveted Pritzker Prize in 1999.
